Sub:
Clarification to the Transfer Policy for Group 'B' Officers in EPFO- reg.
Ma'am/Sir,
Please refer to the Transfer Policy for Group 'B Officers (TP-GB) dated 14.06.2022 (Web
Circular No: 83 of 2022-23) and the amendment to the same issued on 23.12.2022 (Web Circular No:
288 of 2022-23).
2.
In this regard, it is clarified that, in r/o multi Zone States the GB-TC at the Zonal Level shall
comprise of the Senior most RPFC-I from each of the Zones of the State with the RPFC-I of the 3"
Zone (junior most of the three RPFC-Is, where applicable) being a special invitee. It may be noted
that in case of a Multi State Zone (eg: DL & UT), separate GB-TCs will be constituted for each State
except for NER. In the event of an RPFC-I being not clear from the Vigilance angle the next senior
most RPFC-I may be considered for the GB-TC. The Convenor shall also be a member of GB-TC.
(This has the approval of CPFC)
Yours faithfully,
5
(Uma Mandal)
Addnl. P.F. Commissioner (HRD)
